bar.title: Bar
bar.text: You drift into the bar. Two familiar figures stand out from the blur of guests:
bar.note: Characters will be dynamically populated by renderer.js based on the randomizer.

pool.title: Pool
pool.text: A warm breeze rolls across the water as you step into the pool area. Laughter and soft chatter echo under the glowing lights.

lounge.title: Lounge
lounge.text: Soft music drifts through the lounge. Plush seating, dim lighting, and intimate conversations fill the room.

balcony.title: Balcony
balcony.text: The city stretches endlessly below as you step onto the balcony. Cool air and glittering lights create a perfect moment.

gameloft.title: Game Loft
gameloft.text: The game loft hums with energy—pool tables, arcade lights, and guests lost in friendly competition.

return_to_main.title: Return to the Main Party
return_to_main.text: You step away and drift back toward the heart of the party.
